recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Only revisit if OO wants to regenerate the Device module diagram from its diagram source-of-truth as a presentation-only update.
issue_request: FHIR-50442 was an Applied, Persuasive OO R6 change request asking the Device module diagram to adjust DeviceRequest pointers so DeviceRequest.subject is represented toward Patient rather than only Device and DeviceRequest.requester is represented toward Practitioner or PractitionerRole.
initial_application: No source commit naming FHIR-50442 was found. Jira says the change was applied in FHIR-50445, and PR #3836 / commit ff73a37610 added images/DeviceModule.svg, registered it in publish.ini, and updated source/device-module.html to use the SVG with representative-diagram wording.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml and publish.ini keep device-module.html and DeviceModule.svg in build scope. The DeviceRequest StructureDefinition already includes Patient and Device for subject and Practitioner/PractitionerRole for requester. The rendered SVG shows DeviceRequest relationships toward the patient/person actor area and Device, while the page text tells readers to review resource definitions for all valid relationships.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. A source edit would be redundant, and a diagram-only SVG edit would not meet the AutoFHIR source-change threshold because the build-scoped narrative and authoritative resource definition already convey the correct relationship semantics.
